hypotheses.title: Batch 66: Completely Orthogonal Frontiers - Solvency, Earnings Certainty, Fair Value Assets, and Book Yield
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pivots completely away from crowded options volatility surfaces and currency translation items to eliminate portfolio self-correlation (< 0.35) and maximize the Uniqueness leaderboard dimension: (1) Balance Sheet Solvency Buffer: Evaluates short-term liquid cash relative to total debt obligations (cash_st / (debt_st + debt_lt + 1000)). Highly liquid firms avoid borrowing distress during tightening cycles. (2) Earnings Certainty & Accrual-Free Quality (model16): Captures firms with high earnings certainty and low accounting accruals (100% instrument coverage). (3) Audited Annual Fair Value Assets Ratio: Measures marked-to-market liquid asset backing relative to total reported assets (fn_assets_fair_val_a / assets). (4) Subindustry Book-to-Price Yield (Fama-French Value): Evaluates tangible book value per share relative to market price over a 180-day baseline.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if solvency buffers or earnings certainty are already fully discounted by market participants.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1: Corporate Balance Sheet Solvency Buffer (Cash over Total Debt)
Candidate 2: Earnings Certainty & Low Accrual Quality (model16, 100% Coverage)
Candidate 3: Audited Annual Fair Value Assets Backing Multiplier
Candidate 4: Subindustry Book-to-Price Fundamental Value Yield
